description.value: Big White Ski Resort is a large four-season mountain resort located above Kelowna in BC's Okanagan Highlands. In summer, it operates a Bike Park and offers guided eBike tours alongside a full village with accommodation, dining, and on-mountain services. The resort is a self-contained destination with restaurants, food trucks, a market, medical services, and online grocery ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is largely navigation menus with minimal prose detail, confirming Big White is an active four-season resort with accommodation, on-site restaurants/food trucks, a grocery ordering service, and cycling-specific offerings (Bike Park, eBike Tours). No specific evidence of secure bike storage, staff bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, e-bike charging, or other touring-cyclist amenities was found in the scraped content. Multiple subpages carry a banner stating 'The resort is closed until July 1,' indicating a seasonal (not permanent) closure.
